ctx.x: Kid Rainy. He had a small band, a lot of small bands, but Rainy and Joe Robichaud had the finest small band. He had the greatest band he had in the late years. Cause he had a drummer by the name of Bucket, he had Porter, he had Gene Ware, Gene Hall,
Gene Ware on trumpet. And Joe on piano. And he had a banjo player by the name of Walter, that's the last, I forgot Walter's other name, but he went to New York.
